{{Quote|The current debate stems over which zero-point year-notation system is the best, with the Great ReSynchronization of 13 years ago and the Ruusan Reformation of a millennium ago being popular contenders.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]|<ref name="HNN 45">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|life/13228_2.html|RM&S; Debates Calendar Reform}}</ref>}}
The following events took place in '''35 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Great ReSynchronization]] occurs,<ref name="SWC" /><ref name="MCBY" /> beginning a [[Great ReSynchronization calendar|new calendar]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="HNN 45" />
*[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], then known as Padmé Naberrie, is made an [[Apprentice Legislator/Legends|Apprentice Legislator]].
*The [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] claims [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] as one of its [[Factory world/Legends|mechworlds]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*[[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]] quits her job as a mercenary pilot for the [[Garqi Agricultural Combine]] and returns to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], becoming leader of the [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]].<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">''[[The Starfighter Trap]]'', Till claims she had quit her mercenary career two years ago, which, given that the story takes place in 33 BBY, allows to arrive at the date of 35 BBY.</ref>
*[[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] became [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*[[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] severs the horn of a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] with his [[Ki-Adi-Mundi's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="SW2">[[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] cuts off a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian's]] horn two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of [[Star Wars (1998) 2|''Star Wars'' (1998) 2]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], two years after '''35 BBY'''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[1994]] reference book ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' originally established that the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] took place in 35 BBY.<ref name="AGttSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> This date was later used by [[West End Games]] as the zero point for the in-universe [[Great ReSynchronization calendar|calendar]] in use in the ''[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]'' articles of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]s'' published in the 90s.<ref name="AJ">''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''</ref> As later sources placed the Clone Wars one decade later,<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s ''[[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]]'' eventually [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] the year 35 BBY as the [[Great ReSynchronization]] to justify its use as a calendar zero point.<ref name="HNN 45" /><ref name="SWC" /><ref name="MCBY" />
